facts.text: Andrew mentions missing nature due to living in the city and tries to visit nearby parks or go on hikes whenever possible.

evidence.quote: Yeah, living in the city, I do miss nature a lot. Whenever I can, I try to go to nearby parks or on hikes. It's such a peaceful and joyful experience for me.

facts.text: Audrey acknowledges the value of nature time and mentions that life has been busy, so she hasn't taken her furry friends out for a walk recently.

evidence.quote: Yeah you're so right about needing nature time. Life's been crazy lately so it's been a while since I took my furry friends out for a walk.

facts.text: Audrey states that moments with her furry friends in nature are described as 'chill and happy' and that they are 'the best companions for exploring the great outdoors'.

evidence.quote: Those moments with them in nature are just so chill and happy! They're definitely the best companions for exploring the great outdoors.

facts.text: Andrew expresses agreement with Audrey's sentiment about nature and animals being peaceful and joyful, and hopes she and her furry friends go on some fun adventures soon.

evidence.quote: Totally agree! Nature and animals can be so peaceful and joyful. I hope you and your furry buddies go on some fun adventures soon!
